answer: For a quiet Capitol Hill spot I'd still point you to the café inside Elliott Bay Book Company — it was the pick last time for exactly this reason, since the bookstore setting keeps things calm and you have a better shot at a quiet corner than at Victrola on Pike or Mr. West. If it's full when you arrive, Porchlight Coffee on 11th is the easy nearby backup, and the seating area in the Capitol Hill Library works as a third option if both are packed. Same low-key framing as before should work well — suggest a rough 60–90 minute window so it doesn't feel open-ended.
